reason: The extraction looked for the JSON-load failure in the shard log before checking its actual text; the shard instead failed on incomplete setup. No VERIFY_REPRODUCED JSON claiming success was written.
consequence: The shell command did not use set -e, so its next report-only loader probe started despite the extraction error. It exited 1 on the JSON load and made no product edits. No shard rerun or repair was attempted.
commentary_correction: The initial reproduction claim was explicitly corrected after inspecting the actual shard log.
phase_receipt_timeout_note: The generic wrapper records its static default 1200; the probe command itself was bounded by timeout 180.
